notes: Stone Bridge (Saint Petersburg) exterior: a single broad granite arch with a continuous open masonry vault, wedge-shaped arch ring, coursed spandrels, rounded cornice, cambered two-carriageway deck, two outer walks, ten capped granite parapet piers and iron oval-loop railing panels. Short skewed bearing aprons meet mapped approaches. Fixed 25 m model datum, approximate 28.5 m end deck and 0.55 m center crown fit the standard viewer field, whose city surface returns are biased above sea level. Standard review water samples 23.437 m. Heights, arch profile and masonry sections are ordinary-photo visualization approximations, not surveyed elevations.
